name: Brill's Karate
what_they_do: Shaolin Kempo karate school on Main St in Spotswood teaching self-defense to children and adults, with age-banded programs (Little Dragons 3.5-5, Peewee, Juniors, Teens, Adult). Also sells birthday parties and runs school/daycare and Scout-troop self-defense events. Owner/instructor Master Barry Brill is named and pictured on the site.
customers: Local families with young children, teens and adults (parent-led purchase); secondary: schools, daycares and Scout/community groups for events.

size_signals.signal: Single location at 508 Main St in Market Plaza; owner-instructor named on site (Master Barry Brill); five age-banded programs plus a Wix Bookings calendar

listing.platform: Birdeye aggregate page (includes ~50 Google reviews; live Google rating not directly confirmed)

website_review.primary_cta: Free trial / 'Schedule a Trial' (links into a Wix Bookings calendar)
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Wix Bookings calendar at /booking-calendar/<program>; on 2026-11-13 it showed 'No availability' for the Adult program
website_review.trust_signals: Named master with photo, two long parent testimonials, embedded map, separate program pages by age, Facebook/YouTube icons
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Legacy non-responsive Wix layout; header and footer email typed as 'BrillsKarate@gmail.com.com'; LocalBusiness JSON-LD postal code 08834 contradicts the 08884 shown in the page footer; booking calendar looked sparsely or not populated
website_review.search_basics: Title 'Self Defense | Spotswood | Brill's Karate | Shaolin Kempo' names the service and town; meta description names Shaolin Kempo self-defense but not the town; program pages exist per age group; no town in the H1
top_issues: No click-to-call: the phone (732-251-0090) and text (732-501-7270) numbers are plain text, zero tel: links on home or booking pages
No contact or trial-request form anywhere; enquiries rely on phone, text or email
Phone layout does not reflow: at 390px the old two-column Wix layout squeezes body copy to a few pixels wide and leaves a large empty band under the content
Typo'd email address (.com.com) in the header and footer of every page
Schema.org LocalBusiness postcode (08834) does not match the real postcode (08884)

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: robots.txt allows all general crawlers (only PetalBot fully blocked, AdsBot partial, lightbox query strings disallowed), so OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and Googlebot are not blocked; sitemap present; a listing exists with 77 aggregated reviews. Answerable: LocalBusiness JSON-LD is present with name, street address, city and telephone, and the page text carries address, phone, program ages and schedule links - but the postcode in the markup is wrong, there is no openingHours, priceRange or service markup, and no FAQ text. Bookable: a real Wix Bookings date/time picker is reachable from 'Schedule a Trial' with no CAPTCHA and no phone call required, though the date checked showed no availability.

operations_signals.signal: Four separate registration buttons on the home page (birthday party, bring-a-buddy, school/daycare event, contest) with no visible intake form behind them - each is manual staff follow-up
Enquiries land in a Gmail inbox and a text number printed in the footer; no structured intake means leads arrive as free-text messages

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the trial funnel: click-to-call/text links, a labelled trial-request form on every page, and real availability in the Wix calendar so a lead can book without phoning
top_opportunities.evidence: Zero tel: links and zero forms on the home page; booking calendar returned 'No availability' for 11/13 while the site's main CTA is a free trial

top_opportunities.opportunity: Responsive rebuild of the page template (readable nav, text, sticky call/book bar on mobile)
top_opportunities.evidence: 390px screenshot shows the desktop two-column layout squeezed to unreadable text, with a large blank band below the content

top_opportunities.opportunity: Intake-and-follow-up agent behind the four event/party registration buttons: capture date, headcount and contact, quote, and chase non-repliers
top_opportunities.evidence: Separate Birthday Party, School/Daycare Event, Bring a Buddy and Contest registration buttons with no form and no online quote path

scores.reasons: Gap: several basics are missing or wrong (no click-to-call, no form, non-responsive phone layout, wrong schema postcode). Pay: single-site school with recurring tuition plus parties/events - modest but real budget. Ease: Wix site that already has Bookings installed, so most fixes are configuration. Evidence: all of the above seen directly on the live site and in its booking calendar.
